source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY1 from first PG548

historical_reviews.deepseek: Incorrectly replaces the source's remote BMC transaction with a physical trace test.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds useful MUX safety and Wistron BMC ownership, but its Manual Only verdict and probing requirement are not source-backed.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row124 uses a different mux address for the second PG548. A response from0x75 cannot prove the first PG548 path through0x71.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Functional I2C connectivity can be partially automated from the BMC, but acceptance requires the authoritative bus/mux/downstream map and reversible state handling.

original_test_intent: Verify the first PG548 path from the BMC I2C-6 controller through mux0x71 port2 to UPHY1 by performing the approved BMC-side mux read/select and confirming the PID1114953-defined downstream replies, without inferring physical continuity from an unrelated bus.
original_method: Map logical BMC I2C-6 to i2c-tools bus5 and first-PG548 mux0x71; record current mux register; confirm port2 bit/value and downstream expected addresses from PID1114953; write0x04 only with approval; query the exact UPHY1/downstream devices; correlate replies and absence of bus errors; restore the recorded mux value and verify other channels/management health.
manual_activity: The BMC/platform owner supplies PID1114953 mapping, confirms exclusive bus access and the safe mux state transition/restoration; no physical probing is required unless separately added by an approved engineering decision.
required_inputs: PID1114953 first-PG548 topology and expected UPHY1/downstream device-address/reply matrix
BMC controller identity proving logical I2C-6 maps to Linux/i2c-tools bus5
Mux0x71 register definition, port2 select value0x04, allowed combined-channel bits and expected pre/post readback
Current mux owner/driver and exclusive access window for forced `i2cget -f` and raw `i2ctransfer`
Exact downstream read transaction(s), success response and timeout/NACK/error criteria
Original mux value, restoration command, independent BMC recovery path and post-restore management checks
safety_requirements: Run only on BMC/platform-management scope with authoritative bus/address map and independent management recovery
Confirm no kernel driver, daemon or concurrent test owns mux0x71 before using force/raw access
Capture the original mux byte and bus health; do not assume0x04 may replace other required channel bits
Perform one approved select and bounded downstream read; abort on NACK, arbitration loss, timeout, stuck bus or management degradation
Restore the exact recorded state and verify all PID-listed devices and BMC management services
agent_execution_scope: Validate controller/bus/mux/port/downstream mapping and collect read-only mux/bus/ownership baseline
After separate approval, execute the exact bounded mux selection and downstream reply checks with restoration
Do not probe/solder hardware, guess BMC bus numbering or downstream addresses, force access without exclusivity, scan blindly, leave mux changed, reset BMC or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve PID map, I2C-6-to-bus5 mapping and expected response matrix
Approve raw mux write, concurrency controls and exact restoration
Resolve whether any separate physical continuity evidence is actually required
Review functional transaction evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incorrect: it declares the source remote procedure non-runnable and substitutes physical probing/soldering not present in the row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping and approval, preserve `i2cget -f -y 5 0x71` and `i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x71 0x04`, then add only the PID-defined downstream read and exact restore; do not claim mux ACK alone proves UPHY1 connectivity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC login, bus5, mux0x71, value0x04, first PG548, UPHY1, PID1114953, Common branch and 15/5-minute scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a controlled BMC-side functional path test through mux0x71 port2 with explicit downstream replies and exact mux restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds measurable downstream acceptance, ownership/concurrency control and restoration while rejecting an unsupported physical-probe substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reading or writing the mux only proves access to0x71; it does not prove the selected path reaches UPHY1 unless expected downstream transactions succeed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Force access and replacing the mux byte can disrupt other BMC channels or management daemons; functional replies do not prove analog signal margin.

project_override_considerations: Per Wistron policy, I2C is BMC/platform-management scope. Require controller, bus, mux address, OOB/recovery and expected response; never infer the path from a generic Linux bus number alone.
expected_evidence: PID1114953 excerpt and BMC I2C-6-to-bus5-to-mux0x71-port2-to-UPHY1 topology
BMC identity, i2c-tools version, bus ownership/concurrency and management-health baseline
Original mux byte plus exact approved read/select transcript and0x04 readback interpretation
PID-defined downstream UPHY1/device transaction outputs, exit codes, timestamps and expected-versus-observed matrix
BMC kernel/daemon/bus-error logs and no unrelated channel/service impact
Exact mux restoration/readback, device/service health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Criteria field provides no functional expected result, while the Procedure says BMC I2C-6 but commands use bus5 without mapping. DeepSeek/GPT V2 add physical probing, soldering and mandatory photos as core coverage although none is specified by the source Procedure.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The functional path, mux and candidate commands are identifiable. Engineering can supply mapping, downstream oracle and restore state, so this is a gated hybrid rather than Manual Only or BLOCKED.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row123 Wistron-HW Robust-00001-V002: provide PID1114953 mapping from BMC I2C-6 to Linux bus5, first-PG548 mux0x71 port2 and exact UPHY1/downstream addresses/replies; define expected initial/readback values, whether0x04 replaces or preserves other bits, bus-owner/exclusive-access rules, measurable PASS/FAIL timeout/NACK criteria, original-state restoration and BMC recovery. Confirm that physical probing/photos are not required unless separately approved.

review_improvement: Restores the source's automatable BMC functional transaction, applies Wistron I2C ownership and adds downstream/original-state evidence instead of inventing a physical-only test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The row explicitly provides BMC i2c-tools commands, so an agent can execute a functional transaction after approval; physical probing is not inherent. However, selecting mux port2 is only an intermediate action. True coverage requires an expected downstream UPHY1 reply and restoration, and the I2C-6 versus bus5 naming difference must be proven by the platform map.
